newsitem.title: USA: Ted Kennedy's daughter has baby boy.
newsitem.headline: Ted Kennedy's daughter has baby boy.

text.p: Kara Kennedy Allen, daughter of Sen. Ted Kennedy, gave birth to a healthy six-pound, four-ounce boy late on Friday, a spokeswoman for the Massachusetts Democrat said.
Kennedy was elated by news that he had a first grandson and a third grandchild, said Melody Miller.
"Christmas came early for the Kennedy family today. This is the greatest Christmas present possible," she quoted the Massachusetts Democrat as saying.
Mother and son, who has not yet been named, were doing well, she said.
Allen and her husband, Michael, an architect, live in Bethesda, Maryland. They have a two-year-old daughter.
Kennedy and his wife Vicky rushed to Shady Grove Adventist Hospital in Rockville, Maryland, after hearing the news.
Upon seeing the baby, Kennedy proclaimed, "He looks just like Grandpa Fitzgerald," the former mayor of Boston and father of Rose Kennedy, Miller said.
